[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | name=Deldrimor Bowl | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=100 }} The [[Deldrimor Bowl]] is an area of relatively lower altitude than the rest of the Northern Shiverpeaks, hence the name. It encompasses the westernmost area under the rule of the [[Deldrimor]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] and lies closest to the [[human]] kingdom of [[Kryta]]. A Dwarven settlement can be seen in the western part of this area. While free of [[Stone Summit]] presence, this area is not without its dangers, as a large population of Shiverpeak [[centaur]]s call this area home. == Getting there == This [[explorable area]] will be traversed as part of the [[primary quest]] [[To Kryta: Refugees]]. It lies to the northwest of [[Beacon's Perch]] and is along the only route connecting [[outpost]]s in the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] to outposts in [[Kryta]]. == Shrines == ; [[Resurrection shrine]]s: * North, at the exit into [[Anvil Rock]]. * Southeast, at the exit into [[Beacon's Perch]]. * Southwest, at the exit into [[Griffon's Mouth]]. == NPCs == === Allies === ==== Services ==== * {{x}} 10 (20) [[Lenn Giantsbane]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Icy Hump]]s) * {{x}} 10 (20) [[Rothgar Hoofsplitter]] (collector for 5 [[Shiverpeak Mane]]s) * {{x}} 20 (20) [[Crafter Torgil]] ([[artisan]]) ==== Other allies ==== * {{r}} 2 (20) [[Ranger Olson]] * {{w}} 5 (20) [[Refugee]] (not before [[To Kryta: Refugees]]) === Foes === [[Centaur]]s * {{w}} 8 (23) [[Shiverpeak Warrior]] * {{r}} 8 (23) [[Shiverpeak Longbow]] * {{mo}} 8 (23) [[Shiverpeak Protector]] [[Ettin]]s * {{w}} 11 (24) [[Snow Ettin]] (only in the southwestern corner) ==== Bosses ==== Centaurs * {{w}} 11 (27) [[Yino Burlyhaunch]] * {{r}} 11 (27) [[Rubi Spottedmane]] * {{mo}} 11 (27) [[Jolo Lighthaunch]] * {{n}} 11 (27) [[Geno Darkheart]] * {{me}} 11 (27) [[Ullo Specterhaunch]] * {{e}} 11 (27) [[Moro Stormcalf]] == Notes == * Groups of 3 to 5 [[Refugee]]s will spawn and move from Beacon's Perch towards to the Griffon's Mouth exit. They will attack hostile [[foe]]s along the way, making them helpful allies (or additional corpses to exploit). * These quests will affect the spawns in this area: [[Hungry Devourer]], [[The Deserters]] and [[To Kryta: Refugees]]. ** The Deserters spawns three allies ([[Cynn]], [[Mehnlo]] and [[Devona]]) next to Beacon's Perch's exit that can be useful for [[vanquish]]ing or [[farm]]ing. * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.9% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] [[title]]. *{{Vanquisher|count = 185|low = 150|high = 210}} ** Shiverpeak Protectors are competent healers due to [[Aura of Faith]]. If your [[party]] cannot overcome their combined healing, it is recommended to restart and adjust [[build]]s/party since this area is full of centaurs with up to 3 to 4 Shiverpeak Protectors per group. Try more offensive setups like playing with only one healer. ***Do not base your party build around [[condition]]s, since Shiverpeak Protectors use [[Mend Ailment]] and [[Purge Conditions]]. ***[[List of enchantment removal skills|Enchantment removal skills]] are highly recommended. ***Centaurs do not possess [[List of hex removal skills|hex removal skills]], degeneration hexes such as [[Crippling Anguish]] or [[Life Transfer]] are incredibly cost-effective counters to [[Healing Breeze]]. ** If the Hungry Devourer quest is not active, [[Moro Stormcalf]] is the only foe that uses [[spell]]s that can [[target]] your party, so avoid bringing [[Guilt]] and [[Mistrust]]. *** All of the [[damage]] inflicted by non-[[boss]] foes is from [[attack]]s, making [[melee counter]]s very effective. ** Shiverpeak Longbows use [[Winter]] and Shiverpeak centaurs have additional [[armor rating]] against [[cold damage]], so avoid using [[elemental damage]], since your party will constantly be within range of a Spirit of Winter (i.e. destroying a Spirit of Winter will cause another Shiverpeak Longbow, possibly in another centaur [[mob]] within [[spirit range]] of the mob your party is attacking, to create another Spirit of Winter). If using a [[spirit spammer]] build, consider using [[Gaze of Fury]] on a Spirit of Winter. ** There are two groups of three centaurs that [[patrol]] clockwise around the map. One group patrols the upper half and one group the lower. If you have not yet vanquished the map, running counterclockwise around the entire outer edge should reveal these groups. {{bug| The [[resurrection shrine]]s in this area do not always show the light animation of an active resurrection shrine: * Upon entry from Anvil Rock, the shrine animation at the Anvil Rock shrine does not work. * Upon entry from Beacon's Perch, the shrine animation at the Beacon's Perch shrine does not work.}} {{Explorable areas in the Northern Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Deldrimor-Becken]]
